title: Options Workstation E2E Verification
description: Complete end-to-end verification of production-grade options workstation with volume profile, advanced indicators, pattern detection, fundamentals, strategy builder, and UI integration

tasks.title: Backend Health & API Verification
steps: Verify backend is running on http://localhost:8000
Test /api/v1/ingest/status endpoint returns live ingestion status
Test /api/v1/options/chain/AAPL with valid expiration returns options data
Test /api/v1/profiles/anchored-vwap/AAPL with anchor_date returns VWAP data
Test /api/v1/fundamentals/AAPL returns fundamentals with all categories

tasks.title: Frontend Load & Trust UX Verification
steps: Wait for app to load (no errors in console)
Verify Trust UX floating badge is visible in top-right
Verify Trust UX shows LIVE mode
Verify Trust UX shows provider health (healthy/degraded/offline)
Verify Trust UX shows last tick timestamp
Click Trust UX to expand data provenance panel
Verify data sources listed (Alpaca for stocks, yfinance for options/fundamentals)

tasks.title: Options Chain UI Verification
steps: Open Options panel (if not visible, enable from menu)
Wait for options chain to load
Verify table shows: Calls (Bid, Ask, Vol, OI, IV) | Strike | Puts (Bid, Ask, Vol, OI, IV)
Click on IV column header to sort

tasks.title: IV Skew Chart Verification
steps: Verify chart loads with Call IV and Put IV lines
Hover over chart to see tooltip with IV values

tasks.title: IV Term Structure Verification
steps: Verify chart loads with ATM IV across multiple expirations
Verify X-axis shows days to expiration
Hover to see expiration date and IV in tooltip

tasks.title: Indicator Manager Verification
steps: Open Indicator Manager dock (should be on right side or accessible via menu)
Verify preset list shows: Volume Profile, Anchored VWAP, ATR Bands, EMA Regime, Pattern Detection
Verify indicator appears in list with visibility toggle, settings, and delete buttons
Click settings icon to edit parameters
Verify both indicators are in list
Toggle visibility for one indicator (eye icon)

tasks.title: Strategy Builder Verification
steps: Verify 'Templates' and 'Add Leg' buttons are present
Verify template list shows: Covered Call, Protective Put, Bull Call Spread, Bear Put Spread, Iron Condor, Straddle
Verify payoff chart displays with profit/loss curve
Verify stats panel shows Max Profit, Max Loss, Breakeven(s)
Click 'Add Leg' to add custom leg
Verify payoff chart updates in real-time

tasks.title: Fundamentals Panel Verification
steps: Verify PROFITABILITY section shows: ROIC, Gross Margin, Operating Margin, Net Margin
Verify CASH FLOW section shows: FCF, FCF Yield, Operating Cash Flow
Verify LEVERAGE section shows: Debt/Equity, Current Ratio, Quick Ratio
Verify QUALITY section shows: ROE, ROA, Asset Turnover
Verify VALUATION section shows: P/E, P/B, P/S
Verify GROWTH section shows: Revenue Growth, Earnings Growth
Verify ADDITIONAL section shows: Market Cap, Enterprise Value, Shares Outstanding
Verify values display correctly (N/A for unavailable, formatted numbers with colors)

tasks.title: End-to-End User Flow
steps: Verify Trust UX shows LIVE mode and healthy providers
Add Volume Profile indicator via Indicator Manager
Verify volume profile overlays on chart (POC, VAH, VAL visible)
Create Bull Call Spread using ATM and OTM strikes
Verify payoff chart shows limited risk/reward profile
Note ROIC and FCF Yield for decision context

tasks.title: Error Handling & Edge Cases
steps: Test invalid symbol in Options Chain (e.g., INVALIDXYZ)
Verify shows 'Add legs to see payoff diagram' message
Test Indicator Manager with max indicators
Verify can add multiple indicators without performance issues
Check browser console for any errors

successCriteria: All backend API endpoints return valid responses
Trust UX displays and updates correctly
Options Chain loads and displays data
IV Skew and Term Structure charts render
Strategy Builder templates work and payoff charts display
Fundamentals panel loads all categories of data
